neighbours.label: ' not' negating an infinitive under a deontic predicate (agree not to, the right not to, asked not to, required not to), vs ' not' negating a finite verb in the same sentence frames
fire: When you sign up, you promise not to share your password with anyone.
Tenants have agreed not to keep pets in the building.
The judge ordered the press not to publish the names of the witnesses.
Every citizen has the right not to testify against himself.
Staff were instructed not to discuss the merger with clients.
By downloading the file, users consent not to resell it.
The coach told the players not to talk to reporters after the game.
Members are obliged not to disclose the contents of the meeting.
quiet: When you signed up, you did not share your password with anyone.
Tenants do not keep pets in the building.
The press did not publish the names of the witnesses.
The citizen does not testify against himself in this case.
Staff could not discuss the merger with clients.
Users who downloaded the file have not resold it.
The players did not talk to reporters after the game.
Members will not see the contents of the meeting until Friday.

predictions: Negated infinitives after agree/right/ask/require/promise reach 0.4-1.0; finite negation (did not, does not) in matched frames stays under 0.1.
notes: Card: ' not' x8 (right not to, agree not to, staff not to refer), plus Arabic يجب/ينبغي (must/should). Probe: agree not to 1.012, the right not to 0.985, required not to 0.551, asked not to 0.413, يجب 0.445; finite 'did not' 0.020 and 0.020, 'stop using' 0.044.
